vetSays.line: 🛡️ Molly, the person in their 50s, Roman and the man in his 50s, with thick glasses met them at the door — 4 put down. Molly, the person in their 50s, Roman, the man in his 50s, with thick glasses are hurt.
🛡️ Bao, Roman, Pablo, Aroha and Nora met them at the door — 5 put down. Bao, Roman, Pablo, Aroha, Nora are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Zoltan just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Roman, Pablo and Tashi met them at the door — 3 put down. Roman, Pablo, Tashi are hurt.
